# UnnecessaryUseAlias

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `UnnecessaryUseAliasInspection`

An import alias identical to the last segment of the imported name
(`use App\Mail\Sender as Sender;`) changes nothing. Drop the `as` clause.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{4,5,6,7} [Before]
<?php
namespace Shop;

use Psr\Log\LoggerInterface as LoggerInterface;
use \Redis as Redis;
use function Util\slugify as slugify;
use Psr\Cache\{CacheItemInterface as CacheItemInterface, InvalidArgumentException};
use Psr\Clock\ClockInterface as Clock;
use Psr\Link\LinkInterface as linkinterface;

class Cart {
    use \Shop\Traits\Totals { total as total; }
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
namespace Shop;

use Psr\Log\LoggerInterface;
use \Redis;
use function Util\slugify;
use Psr\Cache\{CacheItemInterface, InvalidArgumentException};
use Psr\Clock\ClockInterface as Clock;
use Psr\Link\LinkInterface as linkinterface;

class Cart {
    use \Shop\Traits\Totals { total as total; }
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 4: Alias LoggerInterface repeats the imported name; remove it.</li>
<li>line 5: Alias Redis repeats the imported name; remove it.</li>
<li>line 6: Alias slugify repeats the imported name; remove it.</li>
<li>line 7: Alias CacheItemInterface repeats the imported name; remove it.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "UnnecessaryUseAlias": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore UnnecessaryUseAlias

/**
 * @noinspection UnnecessaryUseAliasInspection
 */
```
